entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought last month.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing and preference issue?
It's the fit. They felt fine at first, but after a few long rides, they're giving me really bad blisters. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but nothing helps.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I just need your order number to pull up the details.
Got it, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 36 days ago. You're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy, so I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.

That's great news. I appreciate how simple that was. Since I do need to find a different pair and I'd like to stick with VeloFit, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase, just for the inconvenience of having to send these back?

I understand your request, but our system processes the refund independently, and I'm not able to add a promotional code on top of the return. However, I have just sent the return authorization to your email. It includes a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method.
Alright, that's fair. The free return shipping is helpful. So, I just print the label and I'm all set for the refund?
That's correct. The email has all the instructions. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that covers it. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
